The Sherman County Treasurer’s Office is located on the second floor of the Courthouse in Loup City, NE. The office hours are 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday. The office is open during the noon hour.
Driver's License Examination
Location: Drivers Exam Room, bottom floor of the Courthouse
Time: 10:15 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. & 1:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. Every Tuesday
Phone: 308-745-1425
Duties of the Treasurer's Office:
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
To title and register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
To issue driver licenses, C.D.L's, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, ect.
To disburse collections of the proper political subdivisions
